reason: After thorough review of the CME Group Inc. 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were found disclosed by the company itself. The filing contains extensive financial data, revenue breakdowns by product line (interest rates, equities, foreign exchange, agricultural commodities, energy, metals), and operational metrics, but does not include any company-disclosed TAM estimates for their markets or business segments. CME Group did not provide any addressable market size data in dollars, market share targets, or serviceable addressable market figures in this filing.
